title: Canonical restriction tensor, tensor-power and numerator comparisons
statement: For schemes X,Y [def-pc-scheme], an open immersion j:Y→X and module sheaves F,L [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let C_j(F,G):(F⊗G)|Y≅F|Y⊗G|Y be the unique comparison whose inverse sends every pure tensor of restricted sections to its ambient tensor on the image open [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-tensor-comparison]. Uniqueness is by the sheaf tensor universal property [lem-pc-sites-sheaf-tensor-bilinear-universal]. Define P_j(L,0) as restrictUnitIso j and P_j(L,n+1) as C_j(L,L^n) followed by identity tensor P_j(L,n), using the tensor powers of [def-sc-invertible-module]. Define E_j(F,L,n) as C_j(F,L^n) followed by identity tensor P_j(L,n). These are actual isomorphisms of module sheaves under restriction [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], not arbitrary additive isomorphisms of global section groups.
